units.source_text: “你一去东京，家里又要冷清了，这个家里只有我和你妈。

en.t: Once you go off to Tokyo, the house will feel lonely again; there will be only your mother and me here.

units.source_text: 我的身子骨要是结实也就罢了，可是瞧这样子，说不准啥时候就交待了呢。”

en.t: If I were still strong, that would be one thing, but in this state, who knows when I might suddenly be gone.

units.source_text: 我尽力安慰了父亲一番，回到自己房间。

en.t: I did my best to comfort my father, then returned to my room.

units.source_text: 坐在散乱的书籍中间，我一遍遍回想着父亲那忧心忡忡的神情和话语。

en.t: Sitting among the scattered books, I kept thinking over my father's anxious expression and words again and again.

units.source_text: 这时我又听到了蝉声，那蝉声与前几天不一样，是寒蝉的噪音。

en.t: Just then I heard the cicadas again; their cry was different from the one I had heard a few days before, the rasping sound of late-summer cicadas.

units.source_text: 夏天，我回到故乡时，呆呆地听着此起彼伏的蝉鸣，常常陷入一种莫名的悲哀中。

en.t: In summer, whenever I returned to my hometown and sat blankly listening to the waves of cicada cries, I often sank into an inexplicable sadness.

units.source_text: 我感觉，我的哀愁总是与这昆虫的噪音一起沁入自己的心底。

en.t: It seemed to me that my sorrow always seeped into the depths of my heart together with the noise of those insects.

units.source_text: 每当这个时候，我总是一动不动地凝视着自己。

en.t: Whenever that happened, I would sit perfectly still and gaze into myself.

units.source_text: 今年夏天回家以后，我的哀愁渐渐有了变化。

en.t: After returning home this summer, my sorrow gradually began to change.

units.source_text: 正如油蝉的声音变成寒蝉一样，我感觉我周围的人的命运，也仿佛正在这大轮回中缓慢地运转着。

en.t: Just as the cries of the oil cicadas gave way to those of the late-summer cicadas, I felt that the fates of the people around me were also slowly turning within some vast cycle.

units.source_text: 我反复回想着父亲寂寞的神情和言语，同时又想起一直没有给我回信的先生。

en.t: As I kept recalling my father's lonely expression and words, I also thought again of Sensei, who still had not answered my letter.

units.source_text: 先生和父亲给予我的是完全相反的印象，因而我动辄就想要将二者进行一番比较和联想。

en.t: Sensei and my father gave me completely opposite impressions, and for that reason I was always inclined to compare the two and associate them with each other.
